name: Multi-view Color Consistency and Smoothing
definition: A method to define voxel colour C by weighting colours from the two nearest visible views to compensate for noise from camera calibration, imaging, light balance, and volume quantization.
summary: Multi-view Color Consistency and Smoothing assigns colors to voxels by compensating for noise and handling non-Lambertian reflectance through a blur group mechanism that preserves sharp edges.
